description.value:
Your Lineage offers you a Spirit to choose — a zanpakutō, a Resurrección, or a Schrift. It grants a Release action, a Released Form — permanent changes to your weapon's statistics and traits while released — and a Release Technique, a signature effect costing 1 Reiatsu Point and usable only while released.

Release is not a stance. It doesn't conflict with stance actions, and it lasts the whole encounter.

Release should stay free and permanent-per-encounter. If it cost a point, everyone would Release on round one anyway and feel taxed. The interesting decision is what you do after releasing.
